## 🗺️ Local Business Lead Finder

Turn a business type and a town into a reviewable list of local businesses in Google Sheets — using Apify's Google Maps scraper. Built for agencies, freelancers and small sales teams who need a prospect list to work from rather than a spreadsheet they have to fill by hand.

### How it works
1. **Configure** — set the business type, the location and how many results you want.
2. **Cap** — a built-in ceiling clamps the request so a typo can never trigger a huge paid run.
3. **Find** — Apify searches Google Maps and returns matching businesses with their contact details.
4. **Dedupe** — email addresses already in your sheet are skipped, so your list stays clean.
5. **Save** — the remaining contact rows are appended to the `prospects` tab.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Make your own copy of the companion Google Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nsupXr3uvzcNOjlZuW9Qq92Q6vhXfvekaBnSXT_Ozjs/copy
- [ ] Create a free Apify account and copy your API token.
- [ ] Add it as a **Header Auth** credential — Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
- [ ] Select that credential on the **Find Businesses (Apify)** node.
- [ ] Connect your Google Sheets credential on both Sheets nodes.
- [ ] Paste your copy's Spreadsheet ID into both Sheets nodes.
- [ ] Set your business type and location, then click **Test workflow**.

### Customization
Change `business_type` and `location` for any niche or town. `max_results` sets the size of each run (default 25). Swap the sheet for your own CRM export as long as the column names match.

### 1 · Configure your search
Set the business type, the town and how many results you want. The cap then clamps the request before anything paid happens.

### 2 · Search Google Maps
Apify runs the search and returns matching
businesses. This is the only paid step.

### 3 · Dedupe, then save
Existing rows are read first, so email addresses already in your sheet are skipped. Only new ones are appended to `prospects`.

## ⚠️ Apify is a paid service

**You are billed for places scraped and contact enrichment — not for the rows that reach your sheet.** The number you pay for is always larger than the number of rows you get. Read the real figure in **Apify Console → Runs** after your first search.

**Duplicate filtering happens after the search has already run and billed.** Repeating a search keeps your sheet clean, but it is not free. Matching is on the email address, not the business, so the same business listed under a different email will be saved again.

**Expect fewer rows than you asked for.** Only businesses publishing a usable contact email are kept and system addresses such as `noreply@` are dropped, so a 25-place search commonly saves far fewer rows. Phone, website and address are kept in `notes`.

`max_results` sets each search; a hard ceiling of **500 places per run** is built in.
